technical_and_design_decisions: Establish a common ModuleRegistry abstraction interface defining core methods: getStatus(ModuleDescriptor), listModules(), and getModuleStatuses().
Implement profile-specific Spring @Configuration classes (e.g., @Profile("receptor"), @Profile("cloudcontroller"), @Profile("eureka")) to enable seamless auto-wiring based on execution environment.
Integrate with Cloud Foundry CloudController API and Lattice Receptor client libraries to query runtime container and application metrics.
Utilize Spring Cloud Eureka InstanceInfo metadata map to store custom module properties and enable query capabilities beyond spring.application.name.
assumptions: Development environment includes access to mock/stub services for CloudController, Receptor, and Eureka for integration testing.
The codebase relies on standard Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Stream/Spring XD foundation libraries on Java 17+.
A single software engineer will perform end-to-end design, implementation, testing, and verification.

activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements U1-U8, define SPI interfaces (ModuleRegistry, AdminSPI), and design profile-based auto-configuration mechanisms.

activities.activity_name: Module Registry Abstraction & Repo Foundation (U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Set up dedicated repository module structure, create initial ModuleRegistry abstraction, domain models (ModuleDescriptor, ModuleStatus), and unit test harnesses.
Implement Receptor-backed Admin SPI to query module status, list deployed modules, and fetch health metrics from Lattice/Receptor endpoints.
Implement CloudController-backed Admin SPI to map Cloud Foundry application instances and state to ModuleDescriptor and ModuleStatus.
Configure Spring environment profiles (e.g., cf, ltc, local) and conditional bean registrations for automatic SPI wiring during startup.

activities.activity_name: Eureka Module Self-Registration & Metadata Storage (U6, U8)
activities.activity_description: Implement lifecycle listeners to self-register modules with Eureka upon installation and serialize module state metadata into Eureka's instance registry.

activities.activity_name: Module Search and Discovery by Name (U7)
activities.activity_description: Extend Eureka-backed module lookup logic to query modules by custom module names distinct from default spring.application.name.
Perform end-to-end testing across profile combinations (java -jar, cf push, ltc create) and validate module discovery and health reporting.
